map.输入多个可比房源租金及楼层、朝向、装修、配套等修正系数，自动计算加权参考租金、租: Enter the rents of multiple comparable listings and correction factors such as floor, orientation, decoration and amenities, to auto-compute a weighted reference rent, rent range and annual growth suggestion.
map.「输入多个可比房源租金及楼层、朝向、装修、配套等修正系数，自动计算加权参考租金、: The tool that "enters the rents of multiple comparable listings and correction factors such as floor, orientation, decoration and amenities to auto-compute a weighted reference rent, rent range and annual growth suggestion" performs professional calculation and outputs results based on input parameters.

map.💡 可比租金先换算为单价（元/㎡·月），再乘以（1 + 综合修正系数）得到目标房: 💡 First convert comparable rent to unit price (CNY/m²·month), then multiply by (1 + composite correction coefficient) to get the target property adjusted unit price, and finally multiply by the target area or average by weight.
map.综合修正系数：可比房源优于目标取正值，劣于目标取负值: Composite correction coefficient: positive if the comparable is better than the target, negative if worse
map.相似度权重越大，该案例对最终结果影响越大: The larger the similarity weight, the greater the case impact on the final result
map.可比案例应与目标房源位于同一区域、相似楼龄与配置: Comparable cases should be in the same area as the target, with similar building age and configuration
map.租金区间受淡旺季、租赁周期、议价能力影响: The rent range is affected by seasonality, lease cycle and bargaining power
map.用周边 2–3 套可比房源的单价，经楼层/朝向/装修修正后加权，推算目标房源的参: Use the unit prices of 2–3 nearby comparable listings, corrected by floor/orientation/decoration, then weighted, to estimate the target reference monthly rent.
map.给出租金区间（最低—最高可比单价 × 面积）作为挂牌上下限。: Give a rent range (lowest–highest comparable unit price × area) as the listing upper/lower bounds.
map.按年增长率假设推算次年租金，用于多年租约的递增条款设计。: Estimate next-year rent by the annual growth rate assumption, for designing step-up clauses in multi-year leases.
map.两套可比房源推算 90 ㎡租金: Estimate 90 m² rent from two comparable listings
map.A：月租 5 000 元 / 80 ㎡ / 修正 +5% / 权重 3 → 单价: A: monthly rent 5,000 CNY / 80 m² / correction +5% / weight 3 → unit price 62.50, adjusted 65.63 CNY/m²·month; B: monthly rent 6,500 CNY / 100 m² / correction 0% / weight 2 → unit price 65.00, adjusted 65.00 CNY/m²·month. Weighted unit price = (65.63×3 + 65.00×2) ÷ 5 = 65.38 CNY/m²·month. Target 90 m² → suggested monthly rent 65.38×90 ≈ 5,884 CNY; range 5,850–5,906 CNY; at 3% annual growth, next year about 6,060 CNY.
map.修正系数怎么填？: How to fill the correction coefficient?
map.按可比房源相对目标房源的优劣填: Fill by the comparable relative to the target, better or worse
map.：目标房源更好就给可比房源填正值，更差则填负值。常见维度是楼层、朝向、装修、配套: : if the target is better, give the comparable a positive value; if worse, a negative value. Common dimensions are floor, orientation, decoration and amenities; merge them into one composite percentage.
map.不填目标面积会怎样？: What happens if the target area is not filled?
map.工具会退回到第一个有效可比房源的: The tool falls back to the first valid comparable
map.。建议始终填写目标面积，否则参考租金与实际户型不匹配。: . It is recommended to always fill the target area, otherwise the reference rent will not match the actual layout.
map.关于「租金（市场比较/动态）定价」: About the Rent (Market Comparison / Dynamic) Pricing
map.租金市场比较定价工具，基于可比房源的月租金、面积与综合修正系数，计算目标房源的建: A market-comparison rent pricing tool that, based on comparable listings monthly rent, area and composite correction coefficient, computes the target suggested monthly rent, unit price, rent range and dynamic growth expectation.
map.比准单价 = 单价 × (1 + 综合修正率): Adjusted unit price = unit price × (1 + combined adjustment rate)
map.加权单价 = Σ(比准单价 × 权重) ÷ Σ权重: Weighted unit price = Σ(adjusted unit price × weight) ÷ Σ weights
map.建议月租金 = 加权单价 × 目标面积: Suggested monthly rent = weighted unit price × target area
map.租金区间 = min/max(比准单价) × 目标面积: Rent range = min/max(adjusted unit price) × target area
map.下一年预期租金 = 建议租金 × (1 + 年增长率): Next-year expected rent = suggested rent × (1 + annual growth rate)
map.输入校验：租金、面积、权重均须 >0，综合修正率须在 −50%~+50% 之间: Input check: rent, area and weights must all be >0; the adjustment rate must be between -50% and +50%
map.可比案例按权重输出修正对比表: Comparable cases are output as an adjusted comparison table with their weights
map.输入校验：目标面积必填且 >0；每个已填写案例的租金、面积、权重均须 >0，综合: Input check: target area is required and must be >0; for every partly filled case rent, area and weight must be >0 and the adjustment rate must be within -50% to +50%; growth is only a scenario, also limited to -50% to +50%
map.目标面积必填且须大于 0，不再自动套用可比案例面积: Target area is required and must be greater than 0; comparable area is no longer reused silently
map.完全未填写的案例视为未使用；部分填写错误会逐项提示: A completely blank case is treated as unused; partly filled errors are listed item by item
map.每个有效案例的租金、面积、权重须大于 0，综合修正限 −50%~+50%: For each valid case, rent, area and weight must be greater than 0, and the adjustment is limited to -50% to +50%
map.年增长率仅为情景假设（−50%~+50%），结果需核实面积口径、装修、楼龄与成交: Growth is only a scenario (-50% to +50%); verify area basis, decoration, building age and transaction timing
map.📚 深度解析：市场比较法租金定价与输入边界: 📚 Deep Dive: Market-Comparison Rent Pricing and Input Limits
map.用 2–3 套同区域、相似楼龄与配置的可比房源，把月租换算成单价，经楼层/朝向/: Use 2–3 comparable listings in the same area with similar age and configuration: convert rent to unit price, adjust for floor/orientation/decoration, weight them, and estimate the target rent.
map.目标面积必须明确填写；工具不会再用首个可比案例面积替代，避免户型不匹配却仍输出建: The target area must be entered explicitly; the tool no longer substitutes the first comparable area, avoiding a rent recommendation that does not match the layout.
map.把年增长率当作情景假设而非预测，并查看样本数量、权重合计与口径局限后再用于挂牌或: Treat growth as a scenario, not a forecast; review sample size, total weight and limitations before using it for listing or negotiation.

map.目标面积不填会怎样？: What happens if the target area is blank?
map.会提示「目标房源面积须明确填写为大于 0 的数值」，并停止输出结果。不再自动套用: It reports that the target area must be a value greater than 0 and stops. It no longer reuses the first comparable area, which would mismatch the real layout.
map.为什么有的案例没参与计算？: Why is a case not included?
map.完全未填写的案例视为未使用；只要案例中任意一项有值，就会逐项校验租金、面积、修正: A completely blank case is unused; if any field has a value, rent, area, adjustment and weight are validated, and missing or non-positive fields are listed by case instead of silently filtered.
map.本页不涉及 1.5σ；年增长率仅作情景假设，限制在 −50%~+50%，超出会拒: This page does not involve 1.5σ. Growth is a scenario limited to -50% to +50%; values outside are rejected. Results still need checks on area basis, decoration, building age and transaction timing; a small sample does not represent the market.
map.输入多个可比房源租金与修正系数，目标面积必填；输出加权参考租金、区间和情景增长率: Enter comparable rents and adjustment factors with a required target area; output weighted reference rent, range and scenario growth, with sample limitations.
map.目标面积必填，禁止静默套用案例面积: Target area required; no silent reuse of a comparable area
map.部分填写案例逐项报错，不再静默过滤: Partly filled cases are reported field by field, not silently dropped
